speaker: Ops lead
title: Node failures in the {model} cluster
body: A batch of {chip} boards started throwing memory errors overnight. The run is limping along on the healthy nodes.

choices.label: Swap the bad boards
choices.detail: Pay for replacements and lose a few days restarting.

choices.label: Run degraded
choices.detail: Keep going on fewer nodes for the rest of the run.

choices.label: Pause for a full audit
choices.detail: Lose a week, but find the root cause.

speaker: Model engineering lead
title: {model}: the loss just spiked
body: Training loss jumped and hasn't come back down. It might recover on its own. It might not.

choices.label: Roll back to the last checkpoint
choices.detail: Safe. Costs about a week of progress.

choices.label: Push through
choices.detail: No time lost, but the model may come out worse.

choices.label: Lower the learning rate
choices.detail: Stable from here on, but slower.

speaker: Research lead
title: Eval questions found in {model}'s training data
body: Part of our data mix contains frontier-eval questions. Our scores would look great — and be wrong.

choices.label: Purge and retrain that stage
choices.detail: Clean, but costs two weeks.

choices.label: Filter and continue
choices.detail: Remove what we can. A small hit to quality.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.detail: Ship the inflated numbers. Someone may notice.

speaker: Comms lead
title: {rival} ships {model}
body: {model} scores {score} on the frontier eval. Reporters are asking for our take.

choices.label: Publish our results
choices.detail: Share our eval numbers and method.

choices.label: Run an API price promo
choices.detail: Pull developers our way for a month.

choices.label: Stay heads-down
choices.detail: Let the next model talk.

speaker: Research lead
title: A star researcher wants in
body: She can join next week, but wants a large signing bonus.

choices.label: Pay the bonus
choices.detail: One more researcher, and the community notices.

choices.label: Pass
choices.detail: Keep the cash.

speaker: Ops lead
title: API outage: 3 hours down
body: A bad deploy took the API offline. Developers are angry on social media.

choices.label: Issue service credits
choices.detail: Refund affected customers and publish a postmortem.

choices.label: Fix it quietly
choices.detail: Maybe nobody remembers by Friday.

speaker: Board chair
title: Investors want a growth story
body: Next week is the investor update. How bold should the forecast be?

choices.label: Promise big growth
choices.detail: Hype pulls users in, but misses get noticed.

choices.label: Stay conservative
choices.detail: Under-promise, over-deliver.

speaker: Policy counsel
title: Regulator requests a model card
body: The AI office wants documentation for our live model: data sources, evals and known risks.

choices.label: Publish a full model card
choices.detail: Costs time and legal review. Builds trust.

choices.label: Send the minimum
choices.detail: Technically compliant.

speaker: Product lead
title: Our model went viral
body: A demo of our model is everywhere this week. Sign-ups are spiking.

choices.label: Ride the wave
choices.detail: Spend on ads while attention is high.

choices.label: Let it play out
choices.detail: Free attention is still attention.

speaker: Fab manager
title: Contamination on {line}
body: Particle counts spiked in the cleanroom around {line}. Wafers in flight may be dirty.

choices.label: Scrap the batch and deep-clean
choices.detail: Lose two weeks of output and $20M, keep the yield.

choices.label: Ship what passes test
choices.detail: Keep running, but yield drops 30% for 6 weeks.

speaker: Fab manager
title: Lithography tool down on {line}
body: A scanner on {line} failed overnight. The vendor can fly a replacement in, at a price.

choices.label: Fly in a replacement
choices.detail: $40M and one week of downtime.

choices.label: Run on the remaining tools
choices.detail: The line runs at half speed for 6 weeks.

speaker: Supply chain lead
title: HBM shortage
body: Our memory supplier cut allocations across the industry. Every line that packages chips feels it.

choices.label: Pay spot prices
choices.detail: $60M to keep our full HBM allocation.

choices.label: Ride it out
choices.detail: Half our HBM allocation for 6 weeks.
